description: This file defines the class EntryPointConfirmOptInHandler, which handles confirmation of email opt-in requests, including processing request parameters, updating email address records, and generating confirmation responses. It also manages the confirmation process for selected emails in a queue.

classes.name: EntryPointConfirmOptInHandler
classes.description: A handler class that manages email opt-in confirmation requests, providing methods for processing individual and bulk opt-in confirmations, and updating related contact, lead, or prospect records.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the handler, invokes appropriate method based on the request, and performs cleanup.

methods.name: callMethod
methods.description: Dispatches the request to the relevant method based on the 'method' parameter.

methods.name: methodConfirmOptInSelected
methods.description: Processes bulk opt-in confirmations for multiple email addresses.

methods.name: methodConfirmOptInUser
methods.description: Handles confirmation of a single email address based on a token, updating related records.

methods.name: getIDs
methods.description: Retrieves related record IDs for a given email and module.

methods.name: setLawfulBasisForEachPerson
methods.description: Sets the lawful basis for consent on related person records.
